Raised in the housing projects of Queens, Ben Mallah entered the US Army as a teenager and discovered property management while stationed in Germany. He earned referral fees finding apartments for fellow soldiers and, after leaving the service, bought an unwanted Oakland house as his first profitable real-estate deal.

Mallah developed that value-add approach through Equity Management Partners, acquiring neglected or under-managed apartments, retail centres and hotels. He keeps management close to ownership, using renovation, stronger leasing and refinancing to improve cash flow before deciding whether to hold or sell. The method ties his investment returns to hands-on improvement rather than passive appreciation.
